gotchas: Guest checkout, no login needed. Flow: search results -> fare -> Traveler Info -> Travel add-ons -> Select seats -> Checkout (travel options step, then payment).

A deep link to the results page works: /en/us/fsr/choose-flights?f=EWR&t=BOS&d=YYYY-MM-DD&tt=1&sc=7&px=1&taxng=1&newHP=True&clm=7&st=bestmatches (tt=1 is one-way). From a non-US egress the homepage pre-fills a local origin; the deep link sidesteps that.

Results: click the cabin button 'United Economy (Main cabin) From $..' to expand the fare options. 'Select United Economy Basic' stays disabled until the 'Basic Economy works for me.' checkbox is ticked; 'Select United Economy Standard' works directly.

Field ids/names are not stable or guessable; role selectors (role=textbox[name="First name required"]) and autocomplete attributes resolve. On Traveler Info: First/Last name textboxes, Month is a native select (combobox 'Month'), Day and Year textboxes, Gender a native select ('Gender required'). No email/phone on that page; contact fields are on the payment step.
Seat map: the 'Skip seat selection' link is an in-page jump link covered by the seat map wrapper; click the page's 'Continue' button instead to go to Checkout without a seat.
Checkout opens on 'United travel options': the insurance decline radio is covered by its label; click label[for="WASCInsuranceOfferOption2"], then 'Next step' to reveal the payment form.

Card fields are inline (not in an iframe) and carry autocomplete attributes (cc-number, cc-exp MM/YY, cc-csc, cc-name). State is a typeahead text input (input[id*="tate" i]), Country a native select defaulting to United States. 'Save your credit card' and marketing-email checkboxes are pre-checked. The final button is 'Agree and purchase'.
The billing address line 1 field has a short maxlength: a full street line was truncated (fill_rejected).
A cookie banner with a 'Close' button sits at the bottom of every page and can intercept clicks; close it first.
Traveler Info: Month and Gender are native selects; select by label ('January', 'Female (F)'). Gender is required and is the usual cause of 'Your form has some errors'.
The proxy connection dropped twice on 2026-10-07 between Travel add-ons and the payment step (resume refused), as on 2026-10-02.
Selecting a fare can stall on 'Loading results...'; the proxy reports it as a stalled_search silent block. Do not retry; hand off.

2026-10-07 optional sign-in: 'Sign in' (first) opens an email-first flyout, email #MPIDEmailField, then the dialog's 'Continue'. The password step was not reached: the stored login's +tagged email was flagged aria-invalid. Guest checkout needs none of it.
